query_text: what temperature can food be accepted at

messages.content: what temperature can food be accepted at

message.content:
If you mean **what temperature food can be safely accepted/received at**, the usual food-safety rule is **cold food at 40°F (4°C) or below** and **hot food at 140°F (60°C) or above**.[1][3][6]

If food is **between 40°F and 140°F**, it is in the **danger zone** where bacteria grow quickly, so it should not be left there for long.[1][3][6]

If you meant **what temperature food should be cooked to**, the safe minimum internal temperatures are: **145°F** for whole cuts of beef, pork, lamb, veal, and similar meats; **160°F** for ground meats; and **165°F** for poultry and reheated foods.[1][5]
